option.saltroad.general.anchor_tooltips: Anchor tooltips to the sides of the screen
option.saltroad.tooltip.showAvg80Price: Show average price of the middle 80% (exclude outliers)
option.saltroad.tooltip.showUnidAvgPrice: Show average price for unidentified items
option.saltroad.tooltip.showUnidAvg80Pri: Show unidentified average price of the middle 80% (exclude outliers)
option.saltroad.tooltip.showWeightedAvgP: Show average price weighted towards cheapest prices
option.saltroad.tooltip.showRangeAvgPric: Show average price of the middle 50th percentile (exclude outliers)
option.saltroad.description.showAvg80Pri: Removes the cheapest & most expensive 10% of item prices before calculating the average price.
option.saltroad.description.showWeighted: Calculates the average price weighted towards the cheapest listing prices (less sensitive to higher prices)
option.saltroad.description.showRangeAvg: Removes the 25th and 75th percentile before caluclating the average of the middle 50% price range
